config.gate_statistic: OLS slope of log(seed geometric mean of ||h(t) - h(0)||_RMS) on log(width)

lr_transfer.loss: mean cross-entropy over the training batches after the last step
lr_transfer.eval_loss: mean cross-entropy over held-out unseen Markov validation batches after the last step

precision.emulation: operands stored in the working dtype, FP32 accumulation, one rounding per stored result; svd_exact is FP64 on the numerical row space
